document.source_file: 46. BRS-161016 Report test material GN YK change dimension improve adhesion(Producft of press line - Glonics - Coating Doojin VN ) 2024.6.27
document.title: BRS-161016 Test material GN YK change dimension (Press Glonics / Coating DooJin VN)

primary_defect.canonical_name: Decap NG YK+MG/PT (Bond spread not good)

document.purpose: Verify whether YK with new coating (DooJin VN) and changed dimension is usable.

test_conditions.changed_factor: Coating supplier = DooJin VN (vs Normal yoke)

conclusions.statement_from_report: NG rate 96% (1st 18/20 NG -> 2nd 30/30 NG) => Can not use, need improve more.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Test 96% vs Normal 0%. With Boutou-source CMG, YK+MG/PT decap bond fails catastrophically while Beijing-source CMG decap on 06-27 passed. Coating-supplier change + Boutou CMG combination causes adhesion failure.

conclusions.statement_from_report: Result check tension MG-S-C of test OK but result in Min spec need improve more.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: MG-S-C Test AVG 67.3 kgf vs Normal 101.18 kgf = 0.665x, 33.5% lower (still passes internal ≥50 kgf, internal spec ≥80 not met for both Test and Normal AVG comparisons - check workbook).

conclusions.topic: Other tests OK on Beijing CMG (06-27)
conclusions.statement_from_report: Decap YK+SMG and YK+MG/PT 06-27 OK, drop test OK, vision 0 NG.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: DooJin VN coating performs equal to Normal on YK+SMG decap, drop, and vision. Failure is specific to Boutou CMG path on 06-28.

troubleshooting_index.defect_name: Yoke decap bond NG with Boutou CMG

suggested_checks.check_item: Suspend Boutou-source CMG with DooJin VN coated YK until adhesion improved
suggested_checks.reason: 06-28 decap NG 96% vs Normal 0%; clean failure mode.

suggested_checks.check_item: Investigate why MG-S-C tension is 33% lower than Normal
suggested_checks.reason: Test AVG 67.3 kgf vs Normal 101.18 kgf; still inside ≥50 kgf internal but below the ≥80 kgf nominal spec.

limitations: Test sample 8-50 pcs; only Beijing+Boutou CMG sources compared; one trial pair of dates.

assumptions: Treated Boutou CMG row (06-28) as the failure event causing the report's 'Can not use' decision.
warnings: Tension C-MG spec text shows ≥80 kgf with internal ≥50 kgf - both Test and Normal show wide variance.
ai_extraction_log.decision_rationale: Same-event Normal exists across decap/drop/vision/tension. Failure is concentrated in YK+MG/PT decap with Boutou CMG on 06-28 (96% NG). Author decision = Can not use, needs improvement.

document.title: BRS-161016 GN YK 치수 변경 자재 시험 (Glonics 프레스 / DooJin VN 코팅)
document.purpose: DooJin VN 코팅 YK + 치수 변경 자재 사용 가능 여부 검증.

k1.normalized_interpretation: Test 96% vs Normal 0%. Boutou C-MG에서 YK+MG/PT decap 본드 대량 실패. 06-27 Beijing C-MG는 0%. 코팅 변경+Boutou C-MG 조합이 접착 실패 유발.

k2.statement_from_report: MG-S-C tension OK이나 Min spec - 개선 필요.
k2.normalized_interpretation: Test AVG 67.3 kgf vs Normal 101.18 kgf = 33.5% 낮음. 사내 ≥50 kgf는 통과하나 ≥80 kgf nominal은 평균만으로는 미달 - 워크북 확인 필요.

k3.normalized_interpretation: DooJin VN 코팅은 YK+SMG decap, drop, vision에서 Normal과 동등. 실패는 06-28 Boutou C-MG 경로에 국한.

hint_0.check_item: DooJin VN 코팅 YK + Boutou C-MG 조합 사용 보류
hint_0.reason: 06-28 decap NG 96% vs Normal 0%, 분명한 실패.

hint_1.reason: Test 67.3 kgf vs Normal 101.18 kgf, ≥80 kgf nominal 미달.

assumptions: Boutou C-MG 행(06-28)이 Can not use 판정 원인.
warnings: C-MG tension 스펙이 ≥80 kgf / 사내 ≥50 kgf - Test/Normal 분산 큼.
log.decision_rationale: 같은 이벤트 Normal 존재. 실패는 06-28 YK+MG/PT decap Boutou C-MG (96% NG)에 집중. 판정 = Can not use, 개선 필요.

document.title: BRS-161016 Thử vật liệu GN YK đổi kích thước (Glonics press / DooJin VN coating)
document.purpose: Xác minh YK coating DooJin VN với kích thước mới có dùng được không.

k1.statement_from_report: NG 96% (18/20 -> 30/30) => Can not use, cần cải thiện.
k1.normalized_interpretation: Test 96% vs Normal 0%. Với CMG Boutou, bond YK+MG/PT fail nghiêm trọng trong khi CMG Beijing (06-27) là 0%. Tổ hợp coating mới + Boutou CMG gây mất kết dính.

k2.statement_from_report: MG-S-C tension OK nhưng nằm gần Min spec, cần cải thiện.
k2.normalized_interpretation: Test AVG 67.3 kgf vs Normal 101.18 kgf = thấp hơn 33.5%. Đạt nội bộ ≥50 kgf nhưng trung bình dưới ≥80 kgf nominal - kiểm tra lại workbook.

k3.normalized_interpretation: Coating DooJin VN tương đương Normal ở decap YK+SMG, drop, vision. Sự cố chỉ ở 06-28 với Boutou CMG.

hint_0.check_item: Tạm ngưng tổ hợp YK coating DooJin VN + CMG Boutou

hint_1.check_item: Điều tra MG-S-C tension thấp hơn Normal 33%
hint_1.reason: Test 67.3 kgf vs Normal 101.18 kgf, dưới spec nominal ≥80 kgf.

assumptions: Coi dòng Boutou CMG (06-28) là sự kiện fail dẫn đến quyết định Can not use.
warnings: Spec tension C-MG ≥80 kgf / nội bộ ≥50 kgf - Test và Normal phương sai lớn.
log.decision_rationale: Có Normal cùng sự kiện. Fail tập trung ở 06-28 YK+MG/PT decap CMG Boutou (96% NG). Quyết định = Can not use, cần cải thiện.
